definition: to go to a big shop that sells food and other goods
exampleSentence: I go to the supermarket on Sunday morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng Chủ nhật tôi đi siêu thị.

definition: to write down what you need to buy
exampleSentence: I make a shopping list before I go out.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lập danh sách mua sắm trước khi ra ngoài.

definition: to move the shopping trolley round the shop
exampleSentence: My son likes to push the trolley.
exampleTranslation: Con trai tôi thích đẩy xe đẩy hàng.

definition: to hold a shopping basket while you shop
exampleSentence: I only need a few things, so I carry a basket.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chỉ cần mua ít đồ nên xách giỏ.

definition: to look at how much something costs
exampleSentence: I always check the price first.
exampleTranslation: Lúc nào tôi cũng xem giá trước.

definition: to try to find something cheap and good
exampleSentence: We look for a bargain at the market.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi chợ để săn hàng giá hời.

definition: to stand in a line and wait your turn
exampleSentence: We waited in the queue for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đứng chờ trong hàng mười phút.

definition: to wait in a line for your turn; American English
exampleSentence: People stand in line outside the shop.
exampleTranslation: Mọi người xếp hàng bên ngoài cửa hàng.

definition: to pay at the place in the shop where you give money
translation: thanh toán ở quầy tính tiền
exampleSentence: You pay at the checkout by the door.
exampleTranslation: Bạn thanh toán ở quầy tính tiền gần cửa.

definition: to put the things you bought into bags
exampleSentence: The cashier helped me pack my bags.
exampleTranslation: Nhân viên thu ngân giúp tôi cho hàng vào túi.

definition: to take your own shopping bag to the shop
translation: mang túi riêng đi mua sắm
exampleSentence: Please bring your own bag to the market.
exampleTranslation: Hãy mang túi riêng khi đi chợ.

definition: to use a small paper or code that gives you a lower price
exampleSentence: I used a coupon and saved five dollars.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng phiếu giảm giá và tiết kiệm được năm đô.

definition: to get your money back for something you returned
exampleSentence: I got a refund for the broken lamp.
exampleTranslation: Tôi được hoàn tiền cho chiếc đèn bị hỏng.

definition: to ask the shop for a bigger or smaller size
exampleSentence: Can I ask for a different size?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi hỏi size khác được không?

definition: to cover a present with paper
exampleSentence: The shop will wrap a gift for you.
exampleTranslation: Cửa hàng sẽ gói quà giúp bạn.

definition: to buy things on the internet
exampleSentence: I shop online because it saves time.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua sắm trực tuyến vì tiết kiệm thời gian.

definition: to follow where a parcel is on its way to you
exampleSentence: You can track a parcel on the website.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể theo dõi bưu kiện trên trang web.

definition: to write your name to show you received a parcel
exampleSentence: You need to sign for a parcel.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần ký nhận bưu kiện.

definition: to look at things in shop windows without buying
translation: đi ngắm hàng, xem đồ không mua
exampleSentence: We window-shop on the weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần chúng tôi đi ngắm hàng.

definition: to argue about a price to make it lower
exampleSentence: You can haggle with the sellers at the market.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể mặc cả với người bán ở chợ.
